predictor_missingness: Common finite observed/model Q eligibility; retain missing predictor values for XGBoost native missing-value handling identically across arms. Unknown verification quality is not coded clean or bad.
temporal_split: Train 2018 through Y-2, validation Y-1, test Y. Keep all eligible January days. Four fixed topology-preserving inner groups in every outer job.
spatial_split: Five leave-one-local-river-group-out jobs per year. All Wurm gauges withheld together. All external labels excluded from every fit and validation.
population: Full eligible local census 2021-2025 in two separate temporal/spatial regimes. External Ahr/Erft/Sieg census 2021-2024 scored once per year using the temporal model trained with all permitted local/donor history.
primary_selection: Reconstructed-discharge RMSE in mm/day; aggregate inner MSE in proportion to contributing river-group counts, then square root.
calibration: Local FDC uses extra held-local past clean labels, labelled separately. Donor FDC uses the same finite historical donor labels allowed for the learner; unknown provider QA remains explicit.
scope: Step 2 only: run 30 chronological/grouped outer jobs and save point estimates/predictions. Steps 3-4 remain pending; no new model or data acquisition.
tuning_storage: Keep every tuning receipt/score/feature list; retain final selected models and all seed predictions. Tuning models are not needed after recording validation scores; original completed models remain untouched.
reuse_policy: Only the verified identical 2021 held-Wurm capacity fits are reused. Slice their test predictions to local Wurm; exclude their diagnostic external predictions from primary Step 2 evaluation.
checkpoint_policy: Atomic per-fit receipts and final-model hashes; resume identical inputs/code/seed. Scientific/input failures are recorded, never silently skipped or rerolled for favourable scores.
uncertainty: Per-year and pooled point estimates in Step 2. Dependence-aware paired uncertainty is saved Step 3, not silently replaced by independent-day intervals.
